title: 2354 NORTH GLOAMING WAY; BOARD FILE NO. 250904
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
2354 NORTH GLOAMING WAY; BOARD FILE NO. 250904
  C.D.: 5 (Councilmember Katy Young Yaroslavsky); Bel Air – Beverly Crest Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Joaquin Greenough
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  EZ Permits, LLC – Hoa “Sean” Nguyen

  Consideration of Application to export 2,223 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Section
  15303 (Class 3) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines (Case No. ENV-
  2023-747-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
